## **Pression publicitaire** {#theme-ads}

<!--ir-theme:ads-->
   **Pression publicitaire.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent pression publicitaire.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 10 sept. 2026 - 29 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs remarquent la pression publicitaire. Cela signale une friction de monétisation et une ouverture pour un concurrent plus propre.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Elijah Quinn_, 29 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Pretty decent but there's a few bugs that lock up the app and the ads are annoying. (edit: lowered to 1 star because its set up so you have to pay for coins, trash.)"
            2. _Jack Müller_, 10 sept. 2026, 4/5: "I have ADHD so it's hard for me to stick to a routine or remember to dk stuff in general. This app really helps because it mixes my to does and routines with entertainment! The only downside is that there are a lot of ads if you don't buy premium"
<!--/ir-theme-->
